reviews.comment:
3 exams at 30 percent each. Intimidating BUT you will know in advance what to expect on the exams. DO THE HOMEWORKS or at a minimum STUDY THEM. they're only 10% but helpful for exam content. lectures are helpful, examples provided are important. 

dude also grades insanely fast.

reviews.comment:
This professor wants you to suffer reading. He explains things well, but sometimes kinda fast (He teach like he hate his job). Dont ask questions, he will make fun of you. Overrall he is rude answering, and no at all approachable.
Tough grader, he will fail you if he can

His lectures are informative but a lot of the material that he includes in homework assignments is not mentioned whatsoever in these lectures. You have to do a lot of outside investigation to be able to answer the questions correctly.

The worst class I had this semester! Doesn't respond to email, doesn't post HW solutions, and when he does post HW solutions there are many mistakes in them. He makes it where you can't skip questions on exams, that's fine and all, but not fine when there's not a correct answer.

2 or 3 homeworks per week - often posted wed and due fri/ sun HW is never graded in time to prepare for exams He reads off lecture slides - very monotonous - very few example problems This class is very difficult to begin with, and this prof made us teach ourselves

reviews.comment: Gives lots of homework, sometimes twice a week. Likes to post homework assignments Thursday evenings and make them due Sundays at 11 pm. Doesn't take attendance often, but notices when people miss class; uses this as a basis for curving test scores. Good lecturer that provides a lot of information, but is very stern.
